name: nansen_smart_money_netflow
description: What is smart money buying or selling (net flow) on chain X — returns tokens ranked by net USD flow from Nansen "Smart Money" wallets (top traders + funds) over a time window. Positive = accumulation, negative = distribution. Example: nansen_smart_money_netflow({ chain: "ethereum", timeframe: "1d", _apiKey: "your-nansen-key" })

timeframe.description: Net-flow window to rank/surface: "1h", "1d" (=24h), "7d", or "30d". Default "1d".

_apiKey.description: Nansen API key from your nansen.ai account (paid — $10/10k credits PAYG).

name: nansen_smart_money_holdings
description: What does smart money hold on chain X — returns tokens currently held by Nansen "Smart Money" wallets on a chain, ranked by USD value held, with holder counts and 24h balance change. Example: nansen_smart_money_holdings({ chain: "ethereum", _apiKey: "your-nansen-key" })

_apiKey.description: Nansen API key from your nansen.ai account (paid — $10/10k credits PAYG).

name: nansen_wallet_profiler
description: Labels & profile for wallet X — returns Nansen labels (e.g. "Smart Money", "Fund", exchange/entity tags) for a wallet address, plus a best-effort USD balance summary. Example: nansen_wallet_profiler({ address: "0x28c6c06298d514db089934071355e5743bf21d60", chain: "ethereum", _apiKey: "your-nansen-key" })

chain.description: Chain the address lives on (default "ethereum"); use "all" to span chains where supported.

_apiKey.description: Nansen API key from your nansen.ai account (paid — $10/10k credits PAYG).
